data.long_meaning: The name Bedhaazin is derived from the Arabic word 'Bada'ah' meaning 'desert' and 'Zaw' meaning 'sun'. The name Bedhaazin carries the meaning “Sunset” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Parents who choose Bedhaazin usually hope their child will grow to embody sunset and live with faith, good character and purpose.
